name: t3code
one_liner: A mobile, web, and desktop app that lets you watch and steer your AI coding assistants (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and more) remotely from your phone.
buyer: A busy engineering manager or solo founder who wants to kick off and babysit long AI coding tasks from their phone while away from their desk.
business_use_cases: A solo founder starts a long AI coding task before leaving the office and approves or steers it from their phone over lunch.
A dev team adopts it so engineers can review and approve agent actions on mobile during a commute or between meetings.
An agency running many client coding agents in parallel uses the dashboard to triage which agent needs attention right now.

money_ideas.idea: A paid team tier with multi-user device management and shared visibility into running agents.
White-labeling the mobile remote-control layer for AI tooling vendors who don't want to build their own app.

steal_this: Build a thin layer on top that pushes a notification each morning summarizing what every agent did overnight — a 'morning digest' nobody has shipped yet.
